title: Temporary Scheduler
description:
Job Title: Repairs Scheduler (Temporary)
Location: Gloucestershire
Contract Length: 3 Months
Hourly Rate: 16.00

Are you an organised and customer-focused individual looking for a temporary role within the housing sector? Our client is searching for a dynamic Repairs Scheduler to join their dedicated Repairs Team! If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy coordinating schedules, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

About the Role:
As a Repairs Scheduler, you will play a pivotal role in delivering a seamless repairs service. Your responsibilities will include:
- Scheduling & Coordination: Efficiently schedule and allocate repair works to trade operatives and external contractors, ensuring customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
- Diary Management: Monitor and adjust daily diaries to maximise productivity and minimise downtime.
- Customer Engagement: Liaise with tenants to arrange convenient repair appointments, providing timely information regarding their home maintenance.
- Fleet Management: Oversee fleet vehicle compliance, coordinating servicing and MOTs, while maintaining accurate mileage records.

Key Responsibilities:
- Proactively manage repair works and ensure effective communication with all stakeholders.
- Raise and manage works orders in the housing system.
- Process supplier invoices for accuracy and timely payment.
- Support the Repairs Support Manager with reporting and KPI measurement.

What We're Looking For:
To succeed in this role, you should possess:
- Experience in office administration and database management; knowledge of the housing sector is a plus!
- Strong organisational and communication skills to effectively engage with both internal teams and external partners.
- A proactive attitude with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage your own workload.
- NVQ level 3 or GCSE in Maths and English (or equivalent); qualifications in database management or business administration are advantageous.

title: Office & Finance Assistant
description:
If you are looking for a career opportunity working in a busy and varied meaty administrative support role then this could be the ideal opportunity for you!

To be successful in this role, you'll need excellent written and verbal communication skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to break down complex problems into clear, practical solutions. This is a very busy and rapidly growing company therefore you would need to feel confident to essentially hit the ground running and relish is doing so.

Our client, based in Stonehouse, Gloucestershire, is looking to recruit an Office and Finance Assistant on a permanent basis. This varied role will play an important part in supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of the office while also assisting with key bookkeeping responsibilities. It's an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a diverse workload, working across different areas, and being a valued source of support within a busy team.

Responsibilities:
- Office Administration: Support the efficient day-to-day running of the office by overseeing reception duties, managing incoming correspondence, maintaining office and kitchen supplies, and providing general administrative support to the wider team and CEO.
- Company Policies: Maintain employee handbooks and company policies, ensuring documentation is kept up to date, amendments are implemented, and signed records are collected and filed for HR compliance.
- Xero Accounting: Assist with basic bookkeeping tasks using Xero, including processing invoices and receipts, reconciling bank transactions, and helping to maintain accurate financial records.
- Meetings & Visitors: Coordinate meeting schedules, send invitations, arrange meeting rooms, and organise refreshments when required.
- Reception & Communications: Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answer incoming telephone calls, and manage emails and other correspondence professionally.
- Stock Control & Record Management: Monitor stock levels, update internal databases, file documentation, and maintain both digital and paper-based records.
- Social Events: Assist with the planning and coordination of company events, including booking venues, managing invitations, and monitoring budgets.
- Research: Carry out market research and gather information to support customer requirements and business initiatives.

Salary - £30-35k depending on experience

Hours Monday Friday 9am 5pm

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire

£30,000 Per Annum + Excellent Benefits! (See Below)

We at JKR are recruiting an enthusiastic individual, for one of our key clients, a growing manufacturing company in Tewkesbury!

Sales Administrator Main Purpose and Scope of Role:

The Sales Administrator is a newly created role at the heart of our client's order-to-delivery process, providing the administrative backbone that allows the Account Management team to focus on customer relationships and account growth.

Working within the Commercial team, the Sales Administrator is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of all customer orders, the maintenance of order data across internal systems (including the company's order-loading system and Salesforce CRM), and the coordination of information between Sales, Supply Chain, and Production to ensure commitments are consistently met.

This is a high-volume, fast-paced role that demands exceptional accuracy, strong organisational skills, and a proactive approach to communication. It also offers a genuine, structured development pathway into Account Management for the right individual who demonstrates the commercial and relationship skills required to progress.

Sales Administrator Main Duties:
- Process incoming customer orders accurately and promptly onto internal systems, ensuring all order details, quantities, pricing, and commercial terms are correctly captured and verified before confirmation
- Enter and maintain sales order information across the company's order-loading system and Salesforce CRM, maintaining data integrity and audit trails for all orders, amendments, and cancellations
- Ensure Supply Chain and Production always have clear, accurate, and timely visibility of material requirements arising from confirmed customer orders, communicating any changes or priority shifts promptly
- Support Account Managers with internal order status queries and coordination activity, ensuring a smooth and well-documented handover of orders from quotation through to fulfilment
- Identify and flag discrepancies, including pricing errors, stock shortfalls, lead time risks, and delivery threats, escalating promptly to the relevant Account Manager or Supply Chain contact with sufficient detail for a timely resolution
- Maintain accurate, auditable records of all order activity, including amendments, cancellations, delivery confirmations, and customer correspondence related to order administration
- Produce regular order status and administrative reports for the Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain teams, highlighting any open issues, overdue actions, or at-risk orders
- Liaise proactively with internal departments including Production, Planning, Quality, and Supply Chain to chase order updates, resolve administrative queries, and ensure customers receive accurate delivery information
- Support the Account Management team during peak periods with quotation administration, customer communications, and general commercial support tasks as directed
- Comply with all Company Health and Safety procedures and contribute to maintaining a safe, organised, and compliant working environment

Sales Administrator Person Specification:
- Sales order processing and administration within a manufacturing, engineering, or technical environment
- Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel at intermediate level or above (data entry, order tracking, reporting)
- Supply chain and production coordination: understanding of how orders translate into material and capacity requirements
- Commercial awareness: pricing structures, order terms, and the importance of accuracy in high-value, technically complex orders
- Proven ability to handle high-volume, fast-paced data entry and order management with a very high level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Experience using a CRM, ERP, or MRP system
- GCSE Maths and English (Grade C / 4 or above) or equivalent - essential for order accuracy and reporting

Working Hours & Benefits:
- 08:30-17:00 Monday-Thursday 08:30-16:00 Fridays
- Quarterly profit-sharing bonus
- 31 days' holiday including Bank Holidays
- Pension - 3% employer 5% employee
- Paid professional development
- Discounts and savings portal
- Wellbeing portal
- Cycle to Work
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Life Assurance policy

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Procurement and Materials Coordinator

Duration: 6 months (extension likely)

Pay rate: Negotiable on experience

Location: Bristol (on site)

Role Summary:

Support the Procurement and Material Control function to ensure the availability of all parts required for the build of various complex systems in a low-volume manufacturing environment.

Key Activities:
- Action RFQs and POs from purchasing BOMs and requisitions to ensure components are available for system builds to meet demanding delivery schedules across both R&D and production.
- Process quotes received and support vendor selection based on price, delivery, and quality, enabling timely customer product delivery. Expedite materials and manage order changes, escalating where necessary.
- Support goods-in, quality control, and stock management processes ensuring all material transactions are recorded in the MRP system. Work with the engineering and production build teams to ensure material handover is clear and flexible according to project needs.
- Provide timely progress and status reports to the Procurement Lead.
- Develop and maintain positive, respected relationships with engineering, procurement, build, and customer teams.

Essential responsibilities:
- Generate POs and follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.
- Support goods-in, stock control, and kitting functions - monitor inventory and maintain accurate system transactions for all stock movements.
- Ensure batch and serial traceability requirements are met across purchasing, receiving, and inventory transactions.
- Report any delays or deviations in a timely manner to the procurement and engineering teams.
- Support other business functions according to business needs.
- Maintain accurate records of procurement activities - POs raised, deliveries received, using existing software and database tools.
- Support general procurement and material control administration as required.

Qualifications / Requirements:
- 3-5 years' experience in purchasing, planning, or materials roles within a manufacturing environment.
- Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems.
- Working knowledge of batch and serial traceability processes and documentation.
- Able to read engineering drawings and understand manufacturing processes.
- Willing to take on a variety of tasks according to business needs.
- Proficient in Excel.
- Strong communication and supplier relationship management skills.
- Enthusiastic about supporting business needs and helping the team achieve goals in a dynamic environment.

Desired characteristics:
- Experience with ERP/MRP systems
- Materials Control experience in a manufacturing environment
- Strong Communication skills (written and oral)
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to transactional accuracy.
- Proactive and responsive, with the ability to manage priorities and follow through on actions in a fast-moving environment.
- Strong problem-solving mindset, with the confidence to identify issues early and escalate where appropriate.
- Able to work effectively across cross-functional teams, building positive relationships with engineering, procurement, quality, and production colleagues.
- Reliable and adaptable, with a willingness to support a broad range of tasks according to business needs.
- Committed to maintaining high standards of record keeping, compliance, and batch/serial traceability.
- Customer-focused, with an understanding of the importance of delivery performance, quality, and clear communication.
